reviews.text: I wanted to take a moment to thank Annie SO MUCH for everything she has done for us. After our last dog died, we decided to get a puppy this time around - all we have had were rescues... and holy smokes were we not ready!!! Annie was so patient with us and responsive, and worked with us to survive the first few months of puppyhood. I don't know what we would've done without her. You can tell she loves dogs, and is very compassionate and knowledgeable. You cannot go wrong with Annie. We will recommend her to anyone we know!

We found Annie when our 7 month old puppy became an adolescent. He started crying in his crate at night, disregarding personal space, and was very difficult to bring out in public. We made the best decision to work with Annie. Within the first visit he was no longer waking and crying at night. We gained peace of mind as we learned how to deter him from playing with and eating socks. He listens wonderfully at home and is quickly becoming a good citizen in outings. Annie provided us with a clear foundation on how to approach challenges as Frank and our family continues to grow. We feel more bonded and in sync with him than we would have ever expected. I recommend Annie yo anyone looking to develop a cohesive working relationship with their dog.

Annie is a wonderful and patient dog/owner trainer. Our Scottie loved her and picked up very quickly on her engaging training tactics. Some topics we trained on were bullying other dogs, keeping attention, obedience, and walking on a leash. She also was very quick to answer all of our questions throughout the process.
